ModMetaData.name: Sociopath
ModMetaData.author: T&B Modding
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Sociopath trait in two strengths: Callous (mild) and Sociopath (full). These are colonists who are charming when things go well, cold when they don’t, and never forget a slight.
Unlike the vanilla Psychopath, they keep a small inner circle (family, lovers, the few people they rate highly) and still grieve for them. Everyone else is a tool or an obstacle.
Both strengths: - Selective empathy: indifferent to strangers’ deaths, executions, organ harvesting and butchery. - The mask: a Charm interaction while content, sharper insults once stressed. - Seen through: insult someone you charmed and they realise it was an act. - Unsettling presence: colonists near a stressed one feel uneasy.
Sociopath only: - Grudge ledger: insults and harm are remembered 3× as long; kindness fades 3× as fast. - Shallow affect: events move their mood only 60% as much. - Thrill need: they get bored. Conflict, violence and manipulation keep it topped up, and assigned hunting, slaughtering or fighting refills it steadily. - Cause-linked breaks: they go after the person they resent, and never mope or go catatonic. - Settling scores: taking it out on the grudge target ends the grudge. - Protective streak: hurt someone in their inner circle and you become their enemy. - Cold under fire: no mental breaks mid-fight, paid for with a mood penalty afterwards.
Also: con artists are always Sociopaths; corporate managers, space pirates and child spies are Callous; nurses, healers and counsellors never get either.
Every number can be tuned, and each optional behaviour switched off, in Options → Mod settings → Sociopath.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save.
